name: Sphynx
description: Sphynx are ancient creatures from the Plane of Knowledge with the body of a lion, tail of a serpent and head of  a humanoid. They are renowned for their wisdom, powerful magic and riddles where failure can result in deadly consequences. These timeless celestials are typically found guarding forbidden knowledge in long-forgotten temples. It is rumored that the blood of a sphynx can cure any ailment, and many foolish adventurers have been destroyed testing that theory.

actions.name: Claw of Wrath
actions.description: The sphynx makes an attack with it's claws, dealing arcane damage.

actions.name: Scorn Ignorance
actions.description: The sphynx targets a creature who has failed the check for the Pose Riddle action and deals a large amount of psychic damage to them.

actions.name: Pose Riddle
actions.description: The sphynx poses a riddle to all creatures within a 20 unit radius, forcing them to make an academics check against the attack roll. Any creature who fails can be targeted by the Scorn Ignorance free action until the start of their next turn. Creatures with a knowledge score of -3 are not affected by this action. This action can only be used once per round.

actions.name: Sphynx's Roar
actions.description: The sphynx lets loose a rumbling roar that deals true damage to all creatures and objects within a  20 unit radius. All creatures who fail this check also become dazed. This attack can only be used once per day.

actions.name: Claw of Judgement
actions.description: The sphynx rakes it's claws against a creature, dealing divine damage.

actions.name: Wing Gust
actions.description: In response to being hit with a Melee Attack, the sphynx flaps it's wings in a 6 unit cone, dealing true damage and shoving all creatures back to the edge of the cone. If any of the affected creatures strike an object before making it to the end of the cone, they take an additional 1d10 true damage.

actions.name: Inhale
actions.description: The sphynx open it's mouth and sucks in air in a 5 unit cone, pulling all large or smaller creatures with the area 3 units closer.

traits.name: Simultaneous Telepathy
traits.description: The sphynx speaks in both a language and telepathically at the same time allowing it's riddles to reach the mind's of deafened creatures.

traits.name: Divine Form
traits.description: The sphynx is immutable. Additionally, the sphynx gains an additional 10 physical mitigation against weapons and ammunition that do not have the blackened property.
